answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph, so influence decays when paths cross weakly connected regions. A sybil cluster appears as a sparse external cut with low conductance φ; conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds cap the probability mass, and therefore aggregate voting weight, that can enter it. Even a marble, basalt, or mesa-themed identity cannot evade this spectral bottleneck without diverse attestations.
